gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.
He was driving too fast, so he crashed.
gaps.sentence: He wouldn't have crashed if he ___ so fast.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect continuous: hadn't been driving.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I was rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing (or having + participle for the earlier action).

gaps.lead: 'Would you like me to carry that?' he offered.
gaps.explanation: offer to do something: offered to carry.

accept: the reason why she was chosen
gaps.lead: They chose her for the lead role because of her voice.
gaps.sentence: Her voice was ___ for the lead role.
gaps.explanation: the reason (why/that) + clause: the reason (why) she was chosen.

gaps.lead: She got up early so that she wouldn't miss the train.
gaps.sentence: She got up early ___ the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive express negative purpose.
